acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Trolls family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Elder Troll, T5, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Wound-History Brood Sovereign (Sovereign) archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two earth construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: A walking landscape of unhealed and re-healed flesh, with multiple heads at different stages of formation, layered scar terrain, mismatched limbs, and weapons from many armies embedded along four visibly rooted wound beds.

Signature mechanic: History Heals Wrong: weapons from a dozen armies divide the Elder's walking landscape into four wound beds. Pulling a spear opens a gash that buds two Scrags; wrenching a rusted sword produces a rope-wielding Bog Troll; feeding a half-formed head completes a Mutant Troll's chosen extra structure; shedding the oldest chest landscape creates a Scarlord healing plate. The Elder chooses one bed by turning its most awake head toward it, while lower Trolls may crawl back into an open bed to be absorbed and accelerate that phase. Permanently severing a bed's pale root scar removes its production option. After two roots fall, different forming heads take control of opposite mismatched limbs, creating alternating tells rather than a simple damage escalation.
battlefieldDuty: Run a production-and-transformation boss encounter that reopens centuries of embedded injuries, buds new lower Trolls from those wounds, and absorbs surviving forms to author the next body phase.
constructionDimensions: Mishealing becomes mineralized load-bearing callus: peat-compressed scar slabs, calcified bone shelves, root-threaded mud nodules, flint lodged in wound rims, and sediment bands record repeated regrowth.

Posture and motion become anchored through rootlike scar tendons, dragging mineralized limbs, localized dust from flexing callus, and pale fracture seams where living tissue still joins hardened mass.
counterplay: Interrupt retreating lower Trolls before absorption, use the selected embedded weapon as leverage to expose its root, sever that root during the production contraction, and reposition between the independently signaled limb attacks after the head-control phase begins. Affinity signal: A root-scar pulls taut and the adjacent mineral seam pales after a committed attack; breaking that living joint drops the heavy regrowth and opens the soft bud beneath.
forbiddenTreatments: Palette-only earth treatment without mineralized scar layers, anchoring, and changed limb weight
Glow-only earth treatment without fracture seams or load-bearing regrowth
Pasted stones that do not emerge from documented wound history
Complete stone bodies that erase wet Troll flesh and active healing
identityInvariants: Tall, stooped, potbellied humanoid silhouette with a small head on a thick neck and disproportionately long arms hanging past the knees.
Bog green, liver-brown, sallow grey, bruise purple, and wet glistening highlights keep living hide distinct from mud and scavenged rags.
Rubbery skin, scar tissue, bark-hard callus, mud, rope, and half-swallowed equipment remain visibly bodily rather than worn as deliberate finery.
Healed-over piercings, embedded bones, lodged weapons, misplaced limbs, stray jaws, and layered scars record prior injury as readable construction history.
Escalation adds accumulated misregrowth rather than simple size: open gashes become knots, alternate organs, defensive scar architecture, and finally a walking archive of incompatible healing.
telegraph: One head opens its eyes, nearby embedded weapons flex outward, and a pale root scar pulses from that head to the selected wound bed while incomplete faces along the route begin mouthing the lower form's tell.
